note: Zone list only. Positions, desk slots and walkways are designed in Phase 2 and written to layout.json in Phase 3.

zones.name: Reception
zones.purpose: Where you arrive. Product name sign, no company logo.

zones.name: Sr. Manager's Office
zones.purpose: The player's home base. The Needs You tray sits on this desk.

zones.name: Leads' Row
zones.purpose: Four lead desks with a view of both wings.

zones.name: Endorsement Bridge
zones.purpose: Hero landmark between the wings. CM endorses approved PRs here and Ops picks them up for PO creation.

zones.name: SAP Station
zones.purpose: Where helpers go to pull lists, load PRs (ME57), convert and amend POs.

zones.name: Mail Dock
zones.purpose: Where Outlook email arrives and leaves. Helpers come here for supplier and A/P emails.

zones.name: Contract Corner
zones.purpose: Conga SOW templates and DocuSign routing.

zones.name: Negotiation Room
zones.purpose: Supplier calls, SOW finalization, negotiation and award.

zones.name: Huddle Room
zones.purpose: Team huddles, escalations, and AI Enablement sessions.

zones.name: Merienda Corner
zones.purpose: Coffee and snacks. Helpers on break hang out here.

zones.name: Logistics Window
zones.purpose: Big window over a small loading dock. Deliveries arrive when POs are received.
